Pure balanced-split algorithm for Revise mode's segment-overflow case: splits at the nearest sentence boundary to the midpoint, both halves above an 80-char floor, no split if no clean boundary exists.

Write mode tool body — full chapter source editor. Thin wrapper around the pre-existing, unmodified ChapterTextPanel/useChapterText (same one Contents uses), giving Write mode identical produced-chapter lock/warning/resync-preview behavior.

frontend/src/pages/Voices/components/met.summary: Frontend-bundled copy of the 39 curated voice archetype rows (design-docs/reference/voice-archetypes/voice_archetypes.json) — hand-maintained TS const, same bundling convention as taxonomy.ts.

Frontend-bundled copy of the 52 tone/timbre phrase fragments (28 Tone + 24 Timbre, design-docs/reference/voice-archetypes/tone_timbre_fragments.json) — raw material for the composed-fallback recording-prompt path.

suggestRecordingPrompt(attrs) — scores VoiceAttributes against the 39 archetypes (class/gender/age exact-match + tone/timbre Jaccard overlap + pace); exact/close match returns that archetype's prompt verbatim, otherwise composes a fallback from a Class-opening line + Pace-cue + tone/timbre fragments. Pure, no API call — mirrors iconPrompt.ts's buildIconPrompt() pattern.
